headline: Off-site road improvement agreement for Procopio development at 36 and 44 Pillsbury Road, plus a Water Special Assessment District hearing and budget workshop.
summary: Discussion of a tentative firefighters' union contract and a road condition presentation are also listed. A continued vote on an off-site improvement agreement with PE Realty Partners is on the agenda too.
items: Resignation of Meridel Allen from the Senior Resources Committee
Presentation on the pavement condition index by Public Works and Kimley Horn
Tentative collective bargaining agreement with IAFF Local 3160, subject to voter approval of cost items
Discuss and schedule a public hearing on the proposed Water Special Assessment District
Authorize Town Manager to sign off-site improvement agreement with PE Realty Partners (Procopio) for 36 and 44 Pillsbury Road
Liaison reports and Town Manager report
location: Moose Hill Council Chambers, 268B Mammoth Road, Londonderry, NH 03053

Receive a presentation from the Department of Public Works and Consultant Kimley Horn regarding the Pavement 
Condition Index (PCI).
(Deputy Director of Public Works James Danis)
The DPW contracted with Kimley Horn to complete a review of all the pavement in Londonderry to get an accurate 
representation of the current conditions. This presentation will describe the results and takeaways, as well as how the 
DPW will use this information moving forward to develop a formalized road program for the town. - This agenda item will 
be amended once supporting documents are available.
Review and Consider Approval of the Tentative Collective Bargaining Agreement with IAFF Local 3160, Subject to 
Voter Approval of the Cost Items.
(Acting Town Manager Kim Bernard / Finance Director Justin Campo)
The Town Council will review and consider approval of the tentative successor collective bargaining agreement between 
the Town of Londonderry and IAFF Local 3160 for the period July 1st, 2027, through June 30th, 2030 to be placed on the 
March 2027 ballot. The agreement was ratified by the union membership on October 15th, 2026. Any approval by the 
Town Council would be subject to voter approval of the applicable cost items at the March 2027 Town Meeting.
1. AGENDA ITEM COVER SHEET_IAFF 3160 TENTATIVE CBA.PDF
2. IAFF LOCAL 3160 -SUMMARY OF SUBSTANTIVE CBA CHANGES.PDF
3. IAFF FINAL CONTRACT 7.1.22 - 6.30.27.PDF
Discuss & schedule a public hearing on the proposed Water Special Assessment District 
(Administrative Services Director Kirsten Hildonen)
1. 2026-11-09 WSAD COVER SHEET.PDF
2. 2026-11-09 WSAD IMPROVEMENT PLAN.PDF
3. 2026-11-09 EXHIBIT A MAP.PDF
4. 2026-11-09 EXHIBIT B LIST OF PROPERTIES IN THE DISTRICT.PDF
OLD BUSINESS
Discuss and authorize the Town Manager to execute the Off -Site Improvement Agreement with PE Realty Partners 
(Procopio).
(Administrative Services Director Kirsten Hildonen and Acting Town Manager Kim Bernard )
This item is being continued from the November 2 Town Council meeting where Councilor Bouchard invoked Councilor 
privilege on this item. Per the notice of decision issued by the Planning Board on April 8, 2026, the Town Council needs 
to approve an Off-Site Improvements Agreement for the new development proposed by Procopio at 36 and 44 Pillsbury 
Road. This Agreement describes the developers' obligations for improving public infrastructure to include roadway 
improvements, signage, pavement marking, and other traffic management measures.
1. 2026-11-02 COVER SHEET_PROCOPIO.PDF
2. 2026-10-26 OIA BETWEEN TOWN AND PROCOPIO.PDF
3. 2026-11-02 PROCOPIO OIA PRESENTATION.PDF
